provenance_notes: Experimental embodiments and their separator strength results, not claims-only ranges.
The copolymer contains both polyethylene and polypropylene; do not treat these rows as pure polyethylene separator measurements.
The publication does not state whether separator strength specimens were electrolyte-soaked. Wet/dry assignment is therefore unresolved.
Tensile strength conversion: kgf/cm2 × 0.0980665 = MPa. Puncture conversion: gf × 0.00980665 = N.
Elongation is excluded from separator properties because its method explicitly uses a 1 mm-thick pressed-sheet specimen.
No separator thickness, porosity, pore size, thermal shrinkage, or temperature-dependent measurements were extracted from this table.
Polymerization-stage temperatures and associated feed/duration conditions were added from the embodiment descriptions and Table 1. They describe synthesis, not property-test temperature.

The eight Comparative Example rows were added from Table 1. Comparative Examples 1-4 are physical PE/UHMWPP mixtures; Comparative Examples 5-8 are polymerization controls and have no separator puncture, tensile, or elongation results reported.
table_excerpt: Table 1; source publication text; row values preserved in normalized fields and original reported units.
